text: どうくつで　はぐれた　ともだちを　ここで　まってるのよ

structure.jp: どうくつで　はぐれた　ともだちを
structure.en: the friend I got separated from in the cave

structure.jp: ここで　まってるのよ

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: どうくつで　はぐれた　ともだち
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. どうくつで　はぐれた　ともだち = 'the friend I got separated from in the cave'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now; てる is the short spoken form. まってる = 'am waiting'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives an explanation; のよ is a soft, feminine way of saying it. まってるのよ = 'I'm waiting, you see'.
